title: Rive State Machine: Exit-Time vs Conditionless — Decision Rule Test Package
purpose: A focused two-experiment harness that operationalises the second-order question Scout's brief left open: does "Exit Time = unchecked" mean the transition fires mid-animation or at animation end? Packages decision rules, measurement columns and a failure taxonomy so a runner can produce a verdict in one browser session without ambiguity about what counts as a pass.
